Its resource ownership/lifetime and a complete separate service boundary are not yet resolved; the existing qualification attribution is factual, not OWN002 approval.

Numeric arrays are data, not automatically collaborator handles, but execution/stream/allocation ownership and neutral representation need full typed/effect qualification. No exemption is recorded.

Reviewed primitive resource identifier: flywire_neuron. Exact pinned FlyWire identity is carried as unbranded int64/tuple[int] values at public boundaries. Keep VALUE001 visible; do not change scientific identity bytes here.
Reviewed primitive resource identifier: neuron_row. Row positions identify neurons within the pin and differ from FlyWire identifiers. Existing int/int32 values are not distinct identifier types.

Reviewed primitive resource identifier: edge_row. Original row positions identify retained connections, including zero and duplicate edges. The int32 representation must not be reinterpreted as a neuron identity.

Reviewed primitive resource identifier: trial. Zero-based trial identity crosses simulation and qualification boundaries as unbranded integers. Time steps and numeric dimensions are coordinate facts and are not invented independent resources.

Reviewed primitive resource identifier: reference_identity. The sealed producer digest is returned as an unbranded str. Distinct identity and consumer port/lifetime checks are still unresolved; source provenance and cache qualification are not waived.

limitations: ANALYSIS FAILED (COV002): This registry and loader are not the complete 37-rule analyzer.
Declaration fingerprints cover inventory.py named functions/classes/module and class assignments, including duplicate overload records; they do not classify every use or effect.

Binding fingerprints are conservative reviewed AST-binding-set tripwires for imports, parameters, stored/deleted names and attributes, global/nonlocal, exception and match names. They do not establish resolved identity, lambda/comprehension scope, capture ownership, call targets, alias flow or effect purity.

Host NumPy arrays are numeric data rather than collaborator implementations. Writable aliases inside frozen records remain unresolved; only ReductionRow has detached immutable-byte evidence in the retained qualification.

MLX device arrays/State/Layout and concrete execution callbacks are not neutral public exports. Representation, lifecycle, array-library effects and scientific admissibility are not waived or changed.

No implicit public permission is granted by Python visibility, package roots or re-exported imports. Only exact registered types/ports and their named fields/properties are public neutral contracts; foreign direct pure-rule calls need separate contract analysis.

All 60 retained evidence Python files are discovered and source-hash frozen; they are handwritten historical source with actual algorithm overrides, not generated/vendor exclusions. Their original environments and imports require historical-resolution coverage before any full pass.

Handwritten Brian2/PyArrow stubs stay first-party checked contract inputs. Adapted Brian2/PyTorch references have exact local and upstream provenance and retain scientific scope; none has a generated-code exemption.

Independent reference-build/execution and native execution-state resource decisions remain unresolved (OWN002/COV001). Primitive registered identifiers remain VALUE001 findings until real distinct neutral contracts are reviewed.

Production declaration role overrides record existing mixed-role/owner responsibilities; they do not authorize incompatible co-location or effect calls. Full placement, graph, call, resource and control-flow checks are not implemented here.

After parent integration, review every incoming comparison/bootstrap/port/module/command declaration and binding set, update only its exact entries and recorded findings, and rerun full policy reconciliation. No build-time auto-classification is provided.
